approved_by: user, 2026-10-08 ('lets do all 3'): out-of-sample test of 20% OTM earnings legs, both sides, half Kelly, on 2021-22 and 2026, before any of those windows' OTM outcomes were computed
thesis: the user's: the payoff structure is the edge. With no direction information (50%), cheap 20% OTM legs bought on both sides of every earnings release, sized by half Kelly, grow capital because the market underprices rare earnings shocks. In 2023-2025 (already reported, OEE-H4) the per-leg mean was +153% but fell to -17.5% without the top 3 events; this test asks whether the shocks recur in windows the OTM tests never used.
inherits: docs/specs/V9_OEE_H4_PREREG_20261008.json (events, admission, timing, leg selection within 2% of the target strike, pricing, spread-model costs at k = 1.0 and 1.5, $0.05 per contract per side, reaction-day expiries at intrinsic)

windows.oos_early: entry days 2021-04-01 .. 2022-02-28 (new OEE-0 table nn_meta/validation/v9-oee0-early-20261008-r0; before the OEE dev window; never used for any OEE outcome)
windows.oos_2026: entry days 2026-01-02 .. 2026-09-14 (the confirmation window; never used for OTM or any OEE outcome; previously used once for V8 H1 stock)

bet: each available 20% OTM leg (call at spot x 1.20, put at spot x 0.80) is one bet; return = net P&L / premium

pass_all_required_pooled_oos.positive: mean net per-leg return > 0 at k = 1.0
pass_all_required_pooled_oos.not_one_shock: mean at k = 1.0 > 0 after removing both legs of the single event with the largest summed leg return

reported_not_gating: each window separately; win rate; payoff quantiles; top-5 concentration
full and half Kelly fractions and log growth per bet (OOS only, and pooled 2021-2026 with the 2023-2025 dev legs)
bootstrap probability that the mean is > 0 (4,000 resamples of legs)
penny-cost sensitivity: an extra $0.01 per share on entry and exit
the same statistics for 10% OTM legs
interpretation: a pass supports forward paper trading at half Kelly (it does not prove the edge: rare-event payoffs need years); a fail with no shocks in the windows means the 2023-2025 result was carried by events that did not recur
single_run: runs once and is reported whatever the outcome

amendment_2026-10-08_preannouncements.defect: the event table includes unscheduled Item 2.02 pre-announcements (and non-earnings 2.02 filings such as Tesla's quarterly deliveries) whose dates nobody knew in advance, violating the inherited assumption that release dates are known >= 5 trading days ahead. Found while checking the first run's top event (IBM 2026-07-14 pre-announcement, -25%).
amendment_2026-10-08_preannouncements.rule: exclude any event whose 8-K is followed by another Item 2.02 8-K from the same ticker within 30 calendar days (nn_meta.v9_oee.preannouncement_flags); filing dates only, no prices. Flags 11 of 267 early-window and 62 of 1,354 main-table events.
amendment_2026-10-08_preannouncements.scope_of_defect: also affects the already-reported OEE-2, OEE-H4, OEE-J and OVE-3 E-family results, which all failed; recorded in docs/EXPERIMENTS.md
